title: Pork Dumplings with Peruvian Twist
description: A twist on traditional dumplings, infused with Peruvian flavors. Tender pork and kissed potatoes make this dish a delight.
instructions: Cook dumplings according to package instructions.
Heat olive oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add ground pork and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add diced kissed potatoes, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add cooked dumplings to the pan and stir to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
